a ♤₅ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ♤₅ (b - 1)) ↶, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ♤₅ (b + 1)) ↶, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
a ♤₇ b = { (a ♤₅ b) ⊕ "a", if a ≡ "ab"; a ♤₅ b, else }
a ▼₈ b = { a, if b == 0; (a ▼₈ (b - 1)) ♤₇ 1, if b > 0 and b <= 8; (a ▼₈ (b + 1)) ♤₇ 1, if b < 0 and b >= - 8 }
a ◇₁₀ b = { (a ▼₈ b) ⇥, if a ≡ "ab"; a ▼₈ b, else }
